call_points.text: Achieved highest-ever consolidated order inflow of ₹1,539 Cr in FY26, up 28% YoY.
Management guides for around 25% YoY revenue growth in FY27, backed by order backlog and rising demand.
Unexecuted order book as of March 31, 2026 stood at ₹1,083 Cr, up 35% YoY.
EBITDA margin in exports sits around 16%-17% compared to 10%-11% in the domestic market.
Margin guidance for FY27 withheld due to volatile steel prices, sea freight rates, and FX swings.
Utilised 53% of net IPO proceeds (₹137.81 Cr out of ₹259.32 Cr) as of March 31, 2026.
Incurred ₹33 Cr capital expenditure during FY26 primarily for capacity expansion and operational strengthening.
FY26 consolidated export revenue reached ₹165.62 Cr, led by demand in North American markets.

guidance.statement: Management targets top-line growth of around 25% year-on-year for FY27.
Management estimates capex for FY27 at around INR 100 crores.
Targeting export revenue of around INR 300 crores in FY27.

operating_notes.text: Secured a domestic PEB and structural steel order worth ₹71.95 Cr with a 7.5-month execution period.
FY26 export revenue reached ₹165.62 Cr, primarily focused on the North American market.
FY26 order inflows reached ₹1,539 Cr, reflecting a 28% YoY increase.
Secured a domestic order of ₹72 Cr in April 2026, following a ₹73 Cr domestic order in Q4FY26.
FY26 new order inflows reached ₹1,539 Cr (+28% YoY).
Export revenue for FY26 reached ₹165.62 Cr.
Unutilised IPO proceeds of ₹124.32 Cr were deployed in fixed deposits and escrow/bank accounts.
Domestic active bid pipeline stood at approximately ₹1,100 Cr across multiple industrial sectors as of May 2026.
Fixed-price contracts cover 80% to 85% of raw materials upon receipt of order, leaving 15% to 20% exposed until engineering finalisation.
Export volumes for Phenix division reached 7,045 tons in FY26, with an FY27 target of 10,000 tons.
Corrected FY26 net operating cash flow to positive ₹89.93 Cr from negative ₹30.88 Cr due to moving ₹120.81 Cr of IPO fixed deposit deployments to investing cash flow.
Commenced commercial production under Phase-I brownfield expansion at Sanand, expanding total PEB capacity from 103,800 MTPA to 123,800 MTPA.

timeline.summary: Girishbhai M. Patel and 97 related promoters declared no new encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for M & B Engineering Limited as of April 3, 2026.
M&B Engineering secured a domestic PEB and structural steel order worth ₹71.95 Cr to be executed within 7.5 months.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹363.71 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹27.36 Cr.
M & B Engineering presented its Q4FY26 & FY26 investor presentation highlighting revenue of ₹1,260 Cr and order book of ₹1,083 Cr.

M & B Engineering Ltd. held earnings conference call on 12th May 2026 with Mr. Chirag Patel, Mr. Malav Patel, Mr. Sanjay Majmudar, and Mr. Keyur Shah discussing audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26.
M&B Engineering filed Crisil's Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹150.68 Cr of ₹275.00 Cr IPO proceeds deployed.
M&B Engineering held its Q4FY26 earnings call, projecting around 25% revenue growth and ~₹100 Cr capex for FY27.
Girishbhai Manibhai Patel, promoter of M & B Engineering Limited, declared no new encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026 on April 6, 2026.
M & B Engineering revised its FY26 operating cash flow to positive ₹89.93 Cr from negative ₹30.88 Cr by reclassifying ₹120.81 Cr of IPO fixed deposits to investing activities.
M & B Engineering commenced commercial production under Phase-I brownfield expansion at its Sanand plant, adding 20,000 MTPA to reach 123,800 MTPA total PEB capacity.
